title: The bug that never reached main
scenario: "A refactor almost broke the product mapping last sprint. Show me the gate that stops it." — Engineering manager (FEAT-03)
mission: Open a PR with a deliberate bug, watch CI block the merge, fix it and merge — nothing from the red commit may reach the registry.
objectives: Read required checks on a protected branch
Prove a red commit produced no artifact

steps.title: Introduce the bug
steps.detail: Return title instead of name in the mapping, keep the test unchanged.

steps.title: Watch it fail
steps.detail: gh pr checks --watch: the app job goes red, merge is blocked.

steps.title: Fix and merge
steps.detail: Push the fix, green, squash merge.

criteria.text: The FEAT-03 PR has one failed and one successful ci run
The PR was merged only after all required checks passed
No image tag in ACR matches the red commit

expectedResult: Proof that the gate works before anything is built for deployment.

concepts.title: Required checks
concepts.body: Branch protection on `main` lists checks that must pass before a PR can merge. A red check blocks the merge button (here even for admins).

concepts.title: Why build only after merge
concepts.body: If images are only built from `main`, a commit that never passed CI can never become a deployable artifact. The PR pipeline gives fast feedback; the main pipeline produces artifacts.

example.title: seeing all runs of a branch
example.body: Each push to the PR branch triggers CI; list them to see red then green:

glossary.def: Rules on a branch: PR required, checks, reviews, linear history.
Keeping PR checks quick so developers fix issues while the context is fresh.

recovery: If merge was possible while red, branch protection is misconfigured — check required checks.
dont: Do not change the test to make it pass
hints: Which workflow runs unit tests on pull requests?
gh run list --branch <branch> shows both runs.

interview.question: What runs on a pull request in your pipeline, and why there?
followUps: How do you keep PR feedback under 5 minutes?

debrief: Required checks + protected main turn tests into a gate; building only after merge means a red commit can never produce a deployable image.

checker.plan: Read-only: gh pr view --json, gh run list for the branch, az acr repository show-tags.
